[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/emdcadvertise\.eastmoney\.com\/infoService\/v\d/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app\.ceair\.com\/customize\/security\/update/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app\.ceair\.com\/customize\/main\/adScreen/i then reject_dict(200)

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, bduserlog.eastmoney.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, js4.eastmoney.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, same.eastmoney.com,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% app.ceair.com
